reapack.name: JS_Build layer variations.lua
reapack.desc: Build aligned layer variations (gunshots, impacts, etc.)

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: New ReaImGui window replaces the old text-box prompt. Window shows the selected layers and how many files each has, and updates live as you change the selection. Transient threshold is now adjustable in the window. Window stays open after Build so you can tweak and build again. Requires ReaImGui (Extensions > ReaPack > Browse packages > ReaImGui).

reapack.name: JS_Wwise Transfer.lua
reapack.desc: Wwise Transfer (send REAPER audio to Wwise)

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Clearer error when the port answers but isn't WAAPI HTTP (e.g. WAMP and HTTP set to the same port)

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Connects over WebSocket (WAMP), like Wwise's own tools, when Mavriq Lua Sockets is installed. Needed for Wwise 2025.1, whose HTTP route returns 404. Keeps one open connection to Wwise, so transfers are faster. Falls back to HTTP otherwise, with a clearer error message.

version.author: Jay Sabins
version.changelog: Back to HTTP only. Nothing extra to install (the Mavriq Lua Sockets option is removed). A refused connection now explains the fix: set "Allow connections from" to 127.0.0.1,::1 in Wwise's User Preferences.
